messages.text: Approved — SSO enforcement for Initech is now a confirmed Q4 commitment, signed off by the Product Lead. This supersedes the earlier informal target and is no longer exploratory.
Update: after capacity review, the export rate limit increase originally targeted for Q4 is now delayed to Q1 next year. Do not communicate this delay to the customer yet.
Exec briefing: Initech is a strategic account this quarter — escalate any SSO delivery risk directly to the VP before it reaches the customer.
